data.name: Mind Reaver
data.description: You can expend a spell slot as a free action to gain additional daily uses of your mind thrust racial power (ML %1).  For each spell level expended, you gain one additional use of your racial ability.  These additional daily uses last only until you recover your spells for the day.|MindReaverML
